is a very mountainous desert, with only a moderate amount of flat plains. Very little vegetation can be seen. Various large buildings line the path, including a water tower. Various railroad lines can be seen. Two locomotives can be seen on the mainline, one of which is where enemies appeared from. One railway bridge crosses over the cave path. A waterfall can be seen to the side of the map.

The map has two entrance points, at the locomotive and the cave. The two sand paths intersect near the end, which is at the bank.

was surrounded by high desert cliffs and encloses a boom town. However, beyond the mountains was a vast expansive desert. There were several mining paraphernalia including a mining railroad and the bank, which you had to defend. Some buildings lined the path and a waterfall with a water tower beside it could be seen. Various dead trees and cacti could be seen around the map.

The map had two entrance points, at the train and the cave. The two dust paths intersected near the end, which was at the bank.
However, there are very few good cliff spots on this map, especially for the cave entrance.
Due to their abilities to buff towers or slow down enemies, the

near the intersection of the paths is recommended as the towers located here can reach a good part of the map.
There are three optimal spots to place ground towers, the first two bends on both the paths and the point where both paths intersect.
Do not rely solely on the point where the paths intersect as it may be very difficult to kill high health or fast enemies due to the lack of path remaining.
Be sure to communicate with your teammates, if you have any. This includes knowing who defends each entrance as it is often wise to divide into two teams defending each entrance.
Enemies are split on this map. This means that every enemy spawned alternates between the entrances.
Enemies are not doubled, though you will need more towers to cover all the places where the enemies spawn.
Most of the major bosses spawn at the cave entrance.
It is recommended to memorize which entrance important enemies like the first
spawn in order to prepare for them on the correct path.

Therefore, relying on them is not recommended, especially for the early game, as they are inconsistent and may not go down the required path.
